rules.statement: The amendment of the final decree was lawful and binding on the respondent, as it corrected an accidental slip or omission in allotting shares.
rules.supporting_quote: "Clearly, therefore, there has been a 'slip or omission' in allotting the shares of the respondent and the plaintiff. Obviously, that slip or omission was not deliberate. It was accidental."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 189 of the Civil Procedure Code, as amended by Ordinance No. 26 of 1930.
